description.content: Check for spam, and submit spam or ham (false positives)
Checks a comment against the Akismet spam database to determine if it is spam or not.

urlencoded.description: (Required) The Akismet API key for authorization.
(Required) The front page or home URL of the instance making the request.
(Required) The IP address of the comment submitter.
The user agent string of the comment submitter's browser.
The name of the comment author. Please provide a name or pseudonym.
The email address of the comment author.
The URL of the comment author.
The content of the comment.
The permanent URL of the entry where the comment was submitted.
The type of the comment. Accepted values are "comment", "trackback", "pingback", or a custom type.
The GMT date and time the comment was created.
The GMT date and time the post containing the comment was last modified.
The ID of the parent comment, if applicable.
The referrer URL of the comment submitter.
The role of the comment submitter.
Indicates whether the submission is a test. Default is false.
The reason for rechecking the comment.
The name of the honeypot field.
The context or location of the comment within the website.
